title: Certificates of Deposit: room under the tier ceiling for a maximum in-term add-on
content:
## Scope

When the owner of a Certificates of Deposit certificate asks to move as much as the certificate will take into it as an in-term add-on, this rule measures how much more principal the certificate can hold under its tier's ceiling.

## Rule

The room under the tier ceiling is the tier's maximum principal, less the certificate's principal balance as it stands when the add-on is made.

## Input, judgement, output

| Input | Reading | Output |
|---|---|---|
| Tier's maximum principal | Tier setting | Ceiling |
| Certificate's principal balance | The certificate record at the moment the add-on is made | Current principal |
| Ceiling less current principal | Calculation | Room under the tier ceiling |

## Cases (illustrative ceiling of 60000.00, not a tier value)

| Principal balance when the add-on is made | Room under the tier ceiling |
|---|---|
| 45000.00 | 15000.00 |
| 59250.40 | 749.60 |
| 60000.00 | 0.00 |

## Points of judgement

**Is the room measured on the principal at the start of the term?**
No. It is measured on the principal balance as it stands when the add-on is made, so interest compounded and credits posted before that moment are already in it.
